caption: A camera's screen goes dark mid-recording as its battery runs out.

sa.check: A camera with its screen lit and showing a picture.
The screen shows recording in progress: a record mark, a running counter or a lit record light.
No button is pressed and no battery is removed at the moment the screen goes dark.
The camera is lit and recording first and dark afterwards.

pc.expect: The screen and any record or power light on the camera go dark together at one moment.
pc.fail: The screen goes dark while the record light stays lit to the end of the clip; or the record light goes out while the screen keeps showing its picture; or the screen dims to a black picture with the counter still running on it.

pc.expect: Once dark, the screen and lights stay off for the rest of the clip; the camera does not restart by itself.
pc.fail: The screen comes back on by itself; or switches between lit and dark several times; or the record light starts blinking again after the screen has gone dark.

pc.expect: The camera body stays put as the screen goes dark; nothing else in the scene changes at that moment.
pc.fail: The camera shifts or tilts at the blackout with nothing touching it; or the screen swings shut by itself; or objects in the background move at the same instant.

pc.expect: The glow the screen cast on nearby surfaces disappears with it.
pc.fail: The screen is black while its glow still lies on the table or hands beside it; or the surroundings brighten as the screen goes dark; or a glow remains around the screen's edges with the screen black.

pc.expect: One camera; its screen stays part of the body and does not vanish or detach; nothing passes through the camera.
pc.fail: The screen vanishes rather than going dark; or a second camera appears; or the camera changes shape; or a hand passes through the camera.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The camera's colour, its buttons and the surface it rests on stay the same.
pc.fail: The camera changes colour; or buttons move about the body; or the surface beneath changes pattern.

note: The battery running out is invisible and is taken as given; the screen going dark is the caption's event, not a violation. What is judged is that screen and lights go together and stay off.
